hypothesis: W-R36 showed that XOR-0x55 byte relabeling reduced accuracy of frozen four-bit sequence classifiers to chance. With 16 weights plus bias and the SAME frozen 1728-example/32-epoch budget, supervised exposure to XOR-coded development data may restore heldout performance at the XOR coding while sacrificing zero-shot transfer to identity. Compare matched fresh-cohort training conditions rather than interpreting frozen W-R34's older training cohort as a matched control.
freeze: Before first first-use freeze development seeds1664..1679, untouched heldout1680..1695, original W-R34 temporal sequence generator, quantizer at four bits, label-preserving identity or XOR0x55 applied to reference AND candidate, two freshly fit equal-budget arms, full per-seed classification and the thresholds below. No post-result edits or hidden cohort screening.
arms: fit_identity trained on fresh-development identity coded raw-base/4-bit candidate, tested under identity and xor55
fit_xor55 trained on identical fresh-development paired labels but both inputs XOR0x55, tested under identity and xor55
primary: CODEBOOK_CONDITIONED_RECOVERY iff fit_xor55 heldout accuracy on XOR inputs exceeds fit_identity heldout XOR accuracy by >=0.10, fit_xor55 XOR accuracy >=0.65 and fit_identity identity accuracy >=0.65. PARTIAL_GAIN iff the gain >=0.05 but strict criterion fails. NO_GAIN otherwise. Report all four accuracies, per-generator/site and per-seed TP/TN/FP/FN, observationally identical pairs, training updates and accuracy on the alternate coding.
controls: No extra model width, sensors, privileged transform inverse, output labels in features, post hoc fit or extra examples
The two arms see matched train labels and seed identity, but different observed byte coding; no heldout fit
Transform XOR occurs AFTER four-bit quantization, as in W-R36, and is applied equally to candidate and base; negative pair preserves anchor and multiset
Independent first-use artifact and required full Go regression/build; no replay, accepted ref mutation, activation or broad cognition claim
claim_limit: Synthetic codebook-conditioned supervised fixed-width temporal classification; restoring transfer by supervised exposure is not zero-shot representation invariance or general intelligence.
